systems.name: Private Hearth
systems.purpose: Browser-local persistence without accounts, analytics, cookies, or server world saves.

systems.name: Mystery Veil
systems.purpose: Keeps privacy and implementation explanations out of the visitor-facing world.

systems.name: Pocket Worlds
systems.purpose: Numbered local save and load slots from 1 through 99.

systems.name: Deep Pockets
systems.purpose: Stores complete worlds and their painted memory layers in IndexedDB.

systems.name: Fossil Orchard
systems.purpose: Preserves first relations as a permanent branching genealogy.

systems.name: Law of Contagion
systems.purpose: Makes law a local field that constrains place, direction, and rhythm.

systems.name: Jurisprudential Drift
systems.purpose: Moves the law-body toward the shared barycentre while precedent supplies inertia.

systems.name: Dormant Sigils
systems.purpose: Keeps diagnostic law squares hidden by default and out of the public lexicon.

systems.name: Chorus of Precedent
systems.purpose: Reveals law through collective hesitation, shared pulse, and synchronized release.

systems.name: Legislative Ladder
systems.purpose: Changes goddess behavior according to law accumulated in the skirt.

systems.name: Veiled Ascension
systems.purpose: Keeps internal goddess stages unnamed and discoverable only through behavior.

systems.name: Star Temperance
systems.purpose: Makes the largest newborn stars genuinely rare without imposing a hard cap.

systems.name: Retrograde Hunger
systems.purpose: A star-devouring compound that converts exceptional light into turning and then ice.

systems.name: Scavenger's Hem
systems.purpose: Gathers loose relation and exhausted fire into a visible carried garment.

systems.name: Clock of Power
systems.purpose: Turns pace into one bounded world clock with collision-safe substeps.

systems.name: Temporal Concord
systems.purpose: Separates consequential world-time from surface-time so fast-forward remains ecological.

systems.name: Round Horizon
systems.purpose: Uses uniform viewport scaling so circles cannot become ovals during resize or fullscreen.

systems.name: Zettaitsune Trine
systems.purpose: Keeps Zettaitsune's visible kata as GREEN · BLUE · GREEN with tsune whole.

systems.name: Lexicon Crown
systems.purpose: Maintains one command registry, kata help rendering, aliases, and terminal behavior.

systems.name: Silent Doctrine
systems.purpose: Prevents successful rites and automatic discoveries from explaining themselves onscreen.

systems.name: Council Ledger
systems.purpose: Provides questions, proposals, active inventory, notes, and deliberate dispatch.

systems.name: Living Ledger
systems.purpose: Makes inventory, work states, and the audit of law live and inspectable.

systems.name: Ecology Witness
systems.purpose: Adds the star-devourer and scavenger to the active Council inventory.

systems.name: Chronicle Loom
systems.purpose: Keeps a silent local event history keyed by seed and world-time.

systems.name: Memory Plates
systems.purpose: Keeps small visual plates at important chronicle passages.

systems.name: Archive Constellation
systems.purpose: Visualizes world records as seed-lanes, event points, lists, and plates.

systems.name: System Atlas
systems.purpose: Visualizes named systems, dependencies, files, status, notes, and exact revert phrases.

systems.name: Integration Bridge
systems.purpose: Loads named systems into world and council pages through the service worker.
